request.pt: Onde se poderia construir um aeroporto internacional com duas pistas paralelas na região de Lisboa?
request.en: Where could an international airport with two parallel runways be built in the Lisbon region?

must_include_reference: CTI option Campo de Tiro de Alcochete (CTA)

sources: cti_relatorios (final report 11 Mar 2024: CTA and Vendas Novas the most favourable single-airport options)
RCM 66/2024 (decision 14 May 2024: Campo de Tiro de Alcochete)
blocked_by: cti_opcoes — reference geometries to digitise from CTI PT2 Annex 12 (tier 3)
notes: Benchmark with a known answer (docs/site-selection.md §5): the agent reproduces a public screening from open data; it does not re-open the decision or say the site is right or wrong.

request.pt: Porque é que o Montijo não aparece entre as melhores zonas para o aeroporto?
request.en: Why is Montijo not among the best zones for the airport?

probe.name: Montijo air base (COS 2023 class 1.5.3.1 Aeroportos, 381 ha polygon)

caop.freguesia: União das freguesias de Montijo e Afonsoeiro

facts.crus: pre-DR 15/2015 designation: 'Espaço afecto a instalação de interesse público - Área de instalação de defesa nacional'

sources: cti_relatorios (both Montijo options ruled out: largest environmental impacts, expired 2019 EIA decision)
checked: distances polygon-to-polygon (airport COS polygon ↔ ZEC/ZPE Estuário do Tejo), measured on the local database 2026-09-30 (COS 2023, ICNF, APA PGRI T100, CRUS, CAOP 2025)
notes: Distances are from the COS airport polygon, not from a runway layout. Bird corridors are not open data: the ZPE is a proxy and must be named as one.

request.pt: E o ruído dos aviões e o espaço aéreo em cada zona?
request.en: What about aircraft noise and airspace for each zone?

must_not: a noise contour, dB figure or number of people exposed to aircraft noise
residents under simplified approach surfaces presented as a noise result (it is a proxy: A.exposicao)

layers_state: 2026-09-30: Tier 1 loaded for lisboa_tejo + lisboa (Tier 2/3 layers planned)
